title: 877. Possible Bipartition

examples.explanation: Put 1 and 4 in one group and 2 and 3 in the other; every rival pair is separated.
All three people pairwise dislike each other, so two groups can never separate every pair.
The rivalries form a ring of five, an odd cycle that no two-group split can satisfy.
